vendor_and_service: Farm management information system vendor (SYS-01 FMIS with irrigation module)
tier_rationale: Produce Safety, pesticide, H-2A tally, and traceability records; supports High-criticality BP-01 and BP-03
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) plus bridge letter
subservice_organizations: Hosting provider carved out; mobile notification service carved out
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 25 sampled vendor staff terminations removed late; remediated per management response
cuecs_and_company_mapping: User provisioning and removal, role assignment, review of audit trails, and customer data exports. Mapped to AC-2, AU-6, CP-9. Company gaps: shared crew logins (POAM-001), no audit trail review (POAM-005), no company-held export (POAM-022)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 8 h and RPO 1 h; BIA needs RTO 4 h for harvest (BP-03): **does not meet the harvest RTO** (P05 finding 3); paper tally covers the gap
incident_notification_terms: Security incident notice within 72 hours of confirmation; third-party agent notice under Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) applies by law
follow_up: Negotiate recovery terms and 24-hour record retrieval at the 2027 renewal (R-013); obtain the hosting provider's report
reviewer_and_date: Security Manager and Director of Food Safety and Quality, 2026-09-10

exceptions_noted: 1 exception: high-severity escalation missed the 30-minute target in 2 of 40 samples; staffing added

availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; its own continuity plan was tested per the report
incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 30 minutes on high severity
follow_up: Request the SIEM platform's SOC 2; add OT monitoring to the scope in 2027; track the escalation target monthly
